title: September at SciTeens
opening: Hey, it's been a while! We're glad to be back in your inbox with fresh science to read, student work to explore, and new ways to find your next STEM opportunity.
We have also revamped the SciTeens website to include a new opportunities section, making it easier to find STEM programs, competitions, and research experiences in one place.
This month, learn why melanoma can spread so quickly, take a look at a student-built Smart Dustbin, and browse new opportunities for your next step in STEM.

featuredArticle.title: Why Melanoma Spreads So Fast: The Hidden Story of BRAF, MAPK and Cellular Chaos
featuredArticle.description: A clear look at how BRAF mutations can put the MAPK pathway into overdrive, helping explain why melanoma is one of the most aggressive skin cancers.

featuredProject.title: Smart Dustbin
featuredProject.description: Explore a student project that applies thoughtful engineering to a familiar everyday challenge.

community.title: Have a friend looking for their next science idea?
